metaDescription: Generate an OpenTelemetry Collector configuration with OTLP receivers, batch and memory limiter processors and exporters wired into traces, metrics and logs pipelines.
intro: Start a Collector configuration quickly, with the processors that production setups normally need.
why:
Choose OTLP over gRPC and/or HTTP, then where traces, metrics and logs go: OTLP to a backend, a Prometheus scrape endpoint, or the debug exporter. The output defines receivers, memory_limiter and batch processors (memory_limiter first, as recommended), the exporters you selected and one pipeline per signal.

The YAML was parsed to check its structure, but not run against a Collector. Component names and options change between Collector versions, so validate with otelcol validate.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Choose receiver protocols and an exporter per signal.
Enter the OTLP endpoint and Prometheus port.
